INTRODUCTION
Zyro Dynamics requires employees to travel from time to time for client meetings, conferences, inter-office work,
and other business needs. This policy governs all business-related travel and expense reimbursements to ensure
that travel is planned cost-effectively, expenses are legitimate and well-documented, and reimbursements are
processed promptly and fairly. All travel must be pre-approved, and all expense claims must be supported by
valid documentation.
SCOPE AND APPLICABILITY
This policy applies to all permanent and fixed-term contract employees of Zyro Dynamics who travel for official
business purposes. Interns and consultants who are required to travel for work must obtain prior approval from
their respective engagement manager and HR before any travel is undertaken.

TRAVEL ADVANCE
Employees may request a travel advance of up to 80% of the estimated total trip cost. The advance request must
be raised through the ZyroHR portal at least 5 working days before the travel date. Any portion of the advance
that is unused must be returned to Finance within 7 working days of returning from the trip. Failure to submit an
expense report or return the unused advance within 30 calendar days of return will result in automatic recovery of
the full advance from the employee's salary.
EXPENSE SUBMISSION AND REIMBURSEMENT
  All individual expenses above Rs. 500 must be supported by an original receipt, GST invoice, or valid digital
invoice. Expenses without supporting documents will not be reimbursed.
 Expense reports must be submitted through the ZyroHR portal within 7 working days of the return date.
Reports submitted after 30 calendar days will not be processed regardless of the reason.
 Foreign currency expenses will be reimbursed in Indian Rupees at the RBI reference exchange rate
applicable on the date of the expense.
 Expenses exceeding the stated policy limits will not be reimbursed unless a prior written exception has been
approved by the Finance Controller.
 Expense reports approved and submitted by the 20th of a month will be reimbursed with the same month's
payroll cycle.
